title: An AUGUR deployment, as a file
description: One file per deployment (deployments/<name>.yaml), read by augurctl (scripts/augurctl). It says what the server should run; augurctl plan says how the server differs from it.

name.description: The deployment's name: the file's name, and its Backstage entry.

ring.description: SERVER_RING: which releases the server takes.

release.description: PLATFORM_VERSION, or follow when the server's updater keeps it on its ring's newest release (a dev workbench).

ssh.description: Where to reach the server: an ssh destination (user@host), or local for this machine.

dir.description: The folder on the server that holds infra/deploy.

settings.description: The .env values that aren't secret, by name (infra/deploy/settings.schema.json). PLATFORM_VERSION and SERVER_RING come from release and ring.

secrets.description: The deployment's secrets, as a sops-encrypted dotenv file, relative to this file.

apps.description: The apps the server runs, each at a version.
